result.summary: This residential intersection features sidewalks and curb ramps but lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signage. Dense vegetation at the corner, specifically a large weeping tree, creates a significant visual obstruction between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalks
hazards.description: The absence of painted crosswalks reduces driver awareness of potential pedestrian activity at the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Across all legs of the intersection

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Large weeping tree and dense shrubs at the corner block the view of pedestrians for drivers approaching the stop sign or turning.
hazards.location_in_image: The corner property on the right side of the image

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim low-hanging branches and dense shrubs at the corner to restore clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the roadway.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with sidewalks and curb ramps but lacks marked crosswalks and visible traffic control. A large tree at the corner provides shade but creates a significant visual obstruction for both drivers and pedestrians at the crossing point.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or prioritized path across the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the intersection of the two streets.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large, low-hanging tree at the corner significantly blocks the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection corner.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or signals are visible to regulate right-of-way at this intersection, which may lead to higher vehicle speeds and crossing conflicts.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire intersection area.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim the large tree at the corner and restrict parking near the intersection to improve sightlines between all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance, slow turning vehicles, and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they step into the street.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection lacking basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and continuous sidewalks. While traffic volume appears low, the wide corner radii and lack of designated crossing areas create a hostile environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Missing Crosswalks
hazards.description: No marked crossings are provided at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross without designated space.
hazards.location_in_image: Center intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps makes the intersection inaccessible for people with mobility devices or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the intersection

hazards.name: Discontinuous Sidewalks
hazards.description: Sidewalks are not present on all sides of the street, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the main road

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint zebra-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all four corners of the intersection.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk network to provide a continuous path of travel on both sides of the street.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection with basic but incomplete pedestrian infrastructure. While sidewalks are present along the properties, the intersection lacks marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and clear signage, and the existing pavement markings are significantly degraded.

hazards.name: Faded Pavement Markings
hazards.description: The lane lines and intersection markings are heavily worn and faded, reducing driver awareness of the intersection geometry.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway and intersection area

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A red vehicle is parked close to the corner, potentially obstructing the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection near the curve

hazards.name: Lack of ADA Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no visible curb ramps at the intersection corners, creating a barrier for pedestrians with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection corners where sidewalks meet the road

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style high-visibility crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian crossing paths and alert drivers.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install ADA-compliant curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all intersection corners to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and motorists.
